instrument: PROTOCOL A13 -- is the rebuilt 0.4.3 reference REPRODUCED, not merely measured?
why_this_file_exists: rebuild_043.sh invoked compare_grads.py at /home/ttuser/of3t-reopen-wt/..., a path inside the CONCLUDED of3t-reopen row's worktree, which fleet hygiene had torn down. The step failed with 'No such file or directory' and exited 2, the script has no failure stop, and run C started anyway. No reproduction_A13_043.json was ever written. A13 had silently not run.
method: sha256 of both runs' full float64 gradient tensors. Stronger than the per-tensor comparison compare_grads.py would have made: byte equality needs no tolerance at all.
note_on_conditions: Two fresh processes of the identical command, 95 minutes apart, on a box whose load went from ~19 to ~44 and back between them, with run B sharing cores three ways. Bit-identity under that is a stronger statement than bit-identity on a quiet box.
verdict: A13 PASSES. The 0.4.3 reference is reproduced bit-identically across two independent processes, so every one of the reference's parameters agrees to the last bit and the downstream trunk arms and run C are built on a verified reference.
owner: of3t-rebase -- this is its deliverable; recorded here because the gate had silently not run and the trunk arms were already consuming the bundle.
